Subject: Kristie Ackert interview
All: Kristie Ackert of the New York Daily News is interviewing for our Tigers job on Tuesday.

Some background on Kristie: She started at the Daily News as a general assignment reporter in 1997. She was promoted to cover the Mets in 2013 and quickly built a reputation as a bulldog reporter in a highly competitive market. Her former editor says her strength is strong sourcing and pivoting away from the mundane low-hanging fruit of a baseball beat. As one person at ESPN told me: “When we go to New York, we make sure to read Kristie Ackert in our research.” Kristie covered the Mets and Yankees in 2018 before transitioning to the Yankees full-time in 2019.
Attached is the itinerary for her visit (with story links) and her resume.
Chris Thomas
Sports editor, Detroit Free Press
Great Lakes regional sports director, USA TODAY Network
cdthomas@freepress.com
@bychristhomas
